description_en: Initiates a remote assistance request from a coordinator to an end user. This is used for administrator assistance scenarios
description_zh: 协同者向终端用户发起远程协助请求。用于管理员协助场景
name: ApplyCoordinationForCoordinator

parameters.help_en:
The initiation type. Valid values:
ADMIN_INITIATE: initiated by an administrator.
ADMIN_INITIATE_FORCE: forcibly initiated by an administrator.
<notice>When an administrator forcibly initiates coordination, end user consent is not required. Submit a ticket to the helpdesk to apply for whitelisting before using this option. Using this parameter indicates that you fully understand and accept the potential compliance risks.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
发起类型。
ADMIN_INITIATE：管理员发起
ADMIN_INITIATE_FORCE：管理员强制发起
<notice>管理员强制发起时，无需终端用户同意。请联系工单支持人员申请白名单后使用，使用此参数表示您已充分了解并接受可能的合规风险。</notice>
parameters.name: initiator_type

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the device used by the initiator when initiating the assistance
parameters.help_zh: 发起协助时，发起者使用的设备唯一标识
parameters.name: uuid

fields.help_en: The convenience account of the resource owner
fields.help_zh: 资源所有者的便捷账号
fields.name: owner_end_user_id

fields.help_en: The unique Wuying identifier of the resource owner
fields.help_zh: 资源所有者的无影唯一标识
fields.name: owner_wy_id

fields.help_en: The region where the resource resides
fields.name: resource_region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of end user resources to assist
parameters.help_zh: 要协助的终端用户资源列表
parameters.name: coordination_resource_candidates
